Configured the DNS hierarchy across pc1–pc31, with pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) as the recursive resolver. The configuration includes all 30 delegations and their glue records, zone apex addresses, `www.example.com`, and both priority-10 MX records. Existing links, IP addresses, and routing were left unchanged.

Static checks verified the zone mappings, delegation and glue entries, and shell syntax. I could not run BIND or start Kathara in this environment, so live resolution remains to be verified. After starting the lab, run [check-dns.sh](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-joil4nwq/lab/shared/check-dns.sh) inside a PC; [DNS-README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-joil4nwq/lab/DNS-README.md) contains the command and diagnostic examples.
